name: kalman_filter_trend_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Traditional moving averages lag price because they weight all observations equally (SMA) or use fixed exponential decay (EMA). A Kalman filter estimates the hidden 'true trend' of price by optimally combining a prediction from a linear state-space model with noisy observations, dynamically adjusting the gain based on the ratio of process noise to observation noise. When the Kalman-estimated trend velocity (the slope state) is strongly positive or negative and the estimation uncertainty is low, we have high-confidence directional signals. The inefficiency exists because Kalman filters require understanding of state-space models and tuning of noise parameters (Q, R matrices), which is beyond most retail traders. The adaptive gain means the filter responds faster to genuine trend changes while smoothing noise.

indicators.name: KF_Level
indicators.params: Kalman filter state[0]: estimated price level; Q=[[0.01,0],[0,0.001]], R=0.1, initialized at first bar

indicators.name: KF_Velocity
indicators.params: Kalman filter state[1]: estimated price velocity (bps per bar)

indicators.name: KF_Uncertainty
indicators.params: sqrt(P[0,0]) where P is Kalman covariance matrix

conditions: KF_Signal_Strength > 2.0 (velocity is statistically significant at ~2 sigma)
close > KF_Level (price above Kalman estimated level)
long.confirmation: KF_Velocity has been positive for at least 5 consecutive bars

short.confirmation: KF_Velocity has been negative for at least 5 consecutive bars

exit.trailing_stop: After 30 bps profit, trail at 15 bps from high-water mark

risk.position_sizing: Scale with KF_Signal_Strength: ₹75K if strength 2.0-3.0, ₹1L if 3.0-4.0, ₹1.25L if > 4.0

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 25; increase observation noise R by 50% if VIX > 20
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:25 (Kalman needs ~10 bars to converge from initialization) or after 15:15
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY 50 KF_Velocity should agree with stock KF_Velocity direction
filters.event_filter: Skip stock on earnings day; re-initialize Kalman filter on earnings day with higher Q (more process noise)
other_filters: KF_Uncertainty must be below 2x the initial uncertainty (filter has converged)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — Kalman filter implementation requires state-space modeling expertise; noise parameter tuning (Q, R) is the moat — poor tuning gives poor signals

weaknesses: Kalman filter assumes linear dynamics with Gaussian noise — financial returns are heavy-tailed and non-linear, violating both assumptions; large gap moves or jumps cause the filter to lag or overshoot
Noise parameters Q and R must be tuned offline and are assumed constant within the session — misspecification (e.g., Q too small) makes the filter sluggish, while Q too large makes it noisy
The filter is recursive from session start, meaning early-session signals are unreliable because the covariance matrix P hasn't converged — typically need 10-20 bars for convergence
prior_art: Kalman (1960) linear filter; applied to finance in Harvey (1990) 'Forecasting, Structural Time Series and the Kalman Filter'; Wells (1998) and Montana et al. (2009) on Kalman filter for pairs trading
notes: Consider using an Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) to handle the non-linearities in price dynamics. The Q and R parameters should be estimated from previous session data using expectation maximization. Python's filterpy library provides efficient Kalman filter implementation.
